# ddsinfo

Third-party DDS inspection utility packaged for the North Star toolbelt.

`ddsinfo` prints information for DDS images or directories of images. It supports dimensions, compression method, recursive scan and wildcard filtering.

## Usage

```bat
tools\toolbelt\third_party\ddsinfo\bin\ddsinfo.exe -r -c -d tools\toolbelt\third_party\ddsinfo\testData
```

This is a binary-only third-party utility. It is packaged as a diagnostic helper, not as a build step.
